key_highlights: ASX inched higher on energy and big miner rally, but iron ore weakness pressures BHP
Australian housing price falls accelerate dramatically; property sector faces 'GFC moment'
RBA unlikely to cut rates to rescue property market, prolonging mortgage stress for households
Multiple gold and uranium discoveries (Forrestania 2Moz, Kaiser, Manhattan, Infini) boost junior miners
BYD confirms Australia has passed EV tipping point, pressuring legacy auto and insurance sectors
China oil import rebound supports crude prices; tanker war risks deemed insufficient to suppress oil
Stokes family retakes control of Seven Network; BBL privatisation greenlit by Cricket Australia

sectors.trend: Iron ore price crumble pressures BHP and FMG, but gold and uranium discoveries (Forrestania 2Moz, Kaiser, Manhattan, Larvotto, Aureka $8.9M acquisition, Infini 7.5% U) drive junior miner enthusiasm
sectors.implications: Large-cap miners face margin compression; junior gold/uranium names attract speculative flows. Diversification within materials is key

sectors.trend: ASX energy stocks rallied; China oil import rebound and tanker war dynamics support crude. Iraq potentially challenging Saudi output. El Niño adds supply risk
sectors.implications: Positive for Woodside (WDS.AX), Santos (STO.AX), and oil-exposed names. LNG pricing supported by China demand

sectors.trend: Accelerating housing price falls and RBA's refusal to ease create credit risk overhang. Mortgage stress driving second jobs. Property 'GFC moment' narrative
sectors.implications: NIM pressure on CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX. Provisioning risk rising. RBA constrained by inflation vs property dilemma

sectors.trend: BYD confirms Australia EV tipping point passed. Car supply crunch writing off vehicles early, jacking insurance premiums. Consumer affordability squeezed
sectors.implications: Headwinds for legacy auto dealers and insurers (WBC.AX, CGU.AX). Opportunity for EV infrastructure and charging plays

sectors.trend: Stokes family retakes Seven Network control. BBL privatisation greenlit. AI regulation debate (Sanders, UN drones) creates uncertainty
sectors.implications: Media consolidation risk. ASX-listed Seven (SVL.AX) governance shift. Defence drone suppliers (e.g., REA.AX) benefit from global demand

sectors.trend: Housing price falls accelerate; property industry faces GFC-level stress. RBA unlikely to intervene. Byron Shire 124-home development cleared
sectors.implications: Negative for property REITs (VCG.AX, DGL.AX) and construction names. Residential REITs under pressure

Underweight property REITs; monitor bank provisioning. RBA unlikely to ease, limiting recovery
Maintain energy and gold hedges. Monitor AUD/USD for safe-haven flows
Favour defensive staples (WES.AX, WOL.AX) over discretionary. Monitor retail sales data
Reduce legacy auto and general insurance exposure; monitor BYD market share data

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound with sector rotation: energy and gold outperform, iron ore and property lag. RBA inaction on property keeps rate uncertainty elevated. Geopolitical headlines add volatility spikes.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural shift toward gold/uranium, energy transition, and defensive consumer. Iron ore oversupply and China slowdown cap large-cap miner upside. Housing correction may extend 12-18 months without RBA intervention. EV adoption accelerates disruption.
